name: Useful check for floating point values
hint: In Scratch the values for x- and y- coordinates are very exact floating point values. An [sbi]<() = ()>[/sbi] check with these numbers can cause problems. To avoid that, you used [sbi]<() < ()>[/sbi] or [sbi]<() > ()>[/sbi] operators.
